source_claim: The official CLAMP FANS SHOP lists “Sakura-chan dress-up costumes” from Tomoyo’s Atelier, including the Black Cat Costume and Prince Costume. This explicitly identifies both listed costume forms as outfits for Sakura Kinomoto.
notes: The shop is the official CLAMP works store and its product titles explicitly state that these are Sakura-chan dress-up outfits. “Kitty” maps to the listed Black Cat Costume; “Sakura Prince” maps to the listed Prince Costume. No other campaign outfit keys are inferred.
